deployment_scope.note: v4.1 keeps the frozen v4.0 selective structural center and joint polling model, and adds a narrow strong-fragmentation full-field TVBS poll recenter gate.

scope: Taiwan county/city executive election candidate vote shares and winner probabilities

architecture.partisan_baseline: Partisan Baseline 4.0A weighted regularized KMT-DPP structural model

fragmentation_poll_gate.trigger_measure: non-KMT/DPP share among decided named-candidate support
fragmentation_poll_gate.action: recenter the posterior draw cloud to the full named-candidate poll vector in centered-log-ratio space while preserving draw shape
fragmentation_poll_gate.partial_ballot_behavior: do not hard-trigger; retain existing joint Gaussian polling likelihood
fragmentation_poll_gate.other_pollster_behavior: do not hard-trigger; retain existing joint Gaussian polling likelihood

winner_probability.method: joint Monte Carlo candidate-share simulation after structural and polling updates

confirmatory_reference_2022.model: v4.0 selective RC3 before fragmentation gate

fragmentation_development_2022.reason_not_confirmatory: The hard-fragmentation architecture was proposed after reviewing earlier 2022 challenger errors.

fragmentation_focus_cases.新竹市: v3 corrected the winner from 沈慧虹 to 高虹安 when the eligible full-field poll showed strong non-major support
fragmentation_focus_cases.苗栗縣: v3 corrected the winner from 謝福弘 to 鍾東錦 after an explicit audited glyph repair 謝褔弘→謝福弘 admitted the TVBS wave as a sensitivity record

stable_blockers: fragmentation gate architecture was proposed after inspection of 2022 challenger errors, so the 4.979pp development result is not a pristine confirmatory holdout
winner probabilities remain uncalibrated across multiple independent election cycles
2009/2010 source rows are web-transcribed and cross-checked but raw workbook hash verification is incomplete
hard fragmentation override is historically validated only with TVBS full-field waves and is intentionally not generalized to all pollsters or partial ballots
